lifecycle.prepare: mkdir -p "$FIXTURES_ROOT/tau-home" "$FIXTURES_ROOT/workspace" "$FIXTURES_ROOT/logs" && PYTHONPATH=../../src TAU_HOME="$FIXTURES_ROOT/tau-home" FIXTURES_VIBES_API_KEY=fixture-local-only ../../.venv/bin/tau --provider fixtures-vibes --model "$FIXTURE_MODEL_ID" --base-url "$FIXTURE_MODEL_URL" --api-key-env FIXTURES_VIBES_API_KEY --timeout-seconds 60 --max-retries 0 --max-retry-delay-seconds 0 --set-default setup
lifecycle.start: PYTHONPATH=../../src TAU_HOME="$FIXTURES_ROOT/tau-home" TAU_AGENTS_HOME="$FIXTURES_ROOT/agents" TAU_LOGS_DIR="$FIXTURES_ROOT/logs" FIXTURES_VIBES_API_KEY=fixture-local-only exec ../../.venv/bin/tau web --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$FIXTURES_PORT" --cwd "$FIXTURES_ROOT/workspace" --database "$FIXTURES_ROOT/tau.sqlite3"
